### Describe the Issue

The extension is not listed in the extensions store

[![Image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/10894885/518058644-49c524b8-c19e-4e11-9476-f8e7df96a36e.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..Wy1SgifK9PRwypHx9FZT1Q-kupf_-HPCYZI2PLk1efQ)](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/10894885/518058644-49c524b8-c19e-4e11-9476-f8e7df96a36e.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..Wy1SgifK9PRwypHx9FZT1Q-kupf_-HPCYZI2PLk1efQ)

Even when I tried to install it manually, an error appeared saying the extension is not compatible with the IDE

### Steps To Reproduce

Search for `C# Dev Kit` or Search by `ms-dotnettools` publisher using Google Antigravity IDE

### Expected Behavior

The extension should be listed

### Environment Information

- OS: MacOS 15.6.1
- IDE: Google Antigravity
- Versions
  - Antigravity Version: 1.11.5
  - VSCode OSS Version: 1.104.0

Reactions are currently unavailable
